programs.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Maria Diekmann"
programs.desc: The Californian Maria Diekmann founded the Rare and Endangered Species Trust, REST in short, to provide care for injured and endangered animals.

programs.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Lizards Gone Wild"
programs.desc: In their increasing efforts to track and trap invasive species, the team is branching out, and for the first time ever they’re on the hunt for the elusive Nile monitor lizard.

programs.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Bayou Roadtrip"
programs.desc: With cold temperatures in Florida putting a freeze on python hunting, the guys head to Louisiana to conduct vital research on invasive reptile species.

programs.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Mother of All Snakes"
programs.desc: Hoping to put a serious dent in the invasive snake population, the guys are determined to track down a massive breeding machine — a legend they call the Mother Burm.

programs.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Tank"
programs.desc: Stacey battles to save a severely injured hunting dog, Millie the calf has been mauled by a dog and the Mark and Stacey work together to change the gender of a cat.

programs.title: Vet Tales S1 - "UFO"
programs.desc: Meg the Labrador has swallowed a UFO, Chocolate the horse is suffering from asthma and Mark and Stacey compete in a chilli eating challenge.
